item.text: I’m opening the reconstructed filing and locating the registrant name in the cover-page text.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/INTEL_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
print(type(data))
print(data.keys() if isinstance(data,dict) else len(data))
if isinstance(data,dict) and 'texts' in data:
    print('texts', len(data['texts']))
    for i, t in enumerate(data['texts'][:20]):
        print(i, t.get('page_no'), repr(t.get('text'))[:200])
PY"
